title: Nine Columns of Drawing
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：chart　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 chart 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 my mother was sent to draw ① chart she could not read, and she said the drawing was the whole of the lesson. The ② chart, meaning the diagram and not the data, was nine columns wide and was drawn by whoever came last; chart, she said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ chart in that office had the same line, and the ④ chart at the end, meaning the one the analysts kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever drew properly. Chart, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ chart was the whole of the report, meaning the trend it carried and not the diagram. The ⑥ chart, meaning the trend and not any of that, is the only thing in a report that everybody cites and nobody questions; chart, he said, is either something you draw or the only word that means both a diagram and a trend. She said the trend is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ chart had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the line. The ⑧ chart of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine columns and eleven years of drawing; chart, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ chart I remember is the one at the end, which was drawn in 1981 and is still described as the clearest in the county. A ⑩ chart, my grandmother said in 1986, is the only thing that improves by being drawn; every chart, she said, is a trend that has agreed to look like a diagram. She said the trend was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 图表（指那张图本身，与那些数据相对）
C. 固定搭配：draw a chart 绘制一张图表
D. n. 图表（指办公室里每一张）
E. n. 图表（指末尾那一张）
F. n. 走势（抽象：它承载的那条趋势）
G. n. 那条趋势（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The chart, meaning the diagram and not the data

answers.why: draw a chart 意为“绘制一张图表”，1961 年母亲被派去绘制她读不懂的那张图表。
chart 意为“图表”，指那张图本身而不是那些数据，宽九列，由最后来的人绘制。
chart 指办公室里每一张图表，每一张都是同样的线条。
chart 指末尾那一张（分析员保留的那一张），是唯一有人认真绘制过的。
chart 意为“走势”，抽象指它承载的那条趋势，父亲说 chart 就是那份报告的全部。
chart 为抽象用法，指那条趋势本身，是一份报告里人人都引用、却没人质疑的东西。
chart 意为“图表”，到 1976 年这张 chart 成了报告里的一个数字。
chart 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九列与十一年的绘制。
chart 意为“图表”，我记得的是末尾那一张，1981 年绘制，至今仍被说成全县最清楚的。
chart 为抽象总称，祖母说一张图表是唯一会因为被认真绘制而变好的东西。
